data: DFUTissue (uwm-bigdata/DFUTissueSegNet), 110 annotated images, AZH Wound Center

held_out_test._note: CORRECTED. Measured by running the DEPLOYED model on DFUTissue's 16-image Test split at three input geometries. Read the two caveats before using any of it.
held_out_test.caveat_not_held_out: This split was NOT held out from this model. The fields above record 104 cases split at random, but DFUTissue ships 94 TrainVal and 16 Test and the trainer globbed both, so roughly 13 of these 16 images were trained on. Every absolute figure here is optimistic. The comparison BETWEEN the three geometries stands, because all three used the same model and the same images.
held_out_test.caveat_five_images: Only 5 of the 16 contain any slough, and the split is unusually granulation-rich (15.6 % of pixels against 5.4 % in TrainVal). An earlier note here said the card's slough figure of 0.564 was overstated because this split gave 0.307. That rested on 5 images and is withdrawn. Cross-validated figures replace it.
